questions.question: 3 frames, reference string 1,2,3,4,1,2,5,1,2,3,4,5. FIFO page faults?
questions.solutionApproach: Faults on first eight references except hits at the 8th and 9th (1,2 still in memory) and the last 5: 12 references - 3 hits = 9 faults. Classic Belady example.

questions.question: Same string with 4 frames, FIFO. Faults?
questions.solutionApproach: Standard Belady example: 10 faults with 4 frames.

questions.question: Which of FIFO, LRU, OPT can show Belady's anomaly?
questions.solutionApproach: Only FIFO; LRU and OPT are stack algorithms.

questions.question: What does the dirty bit avoid?
questions.solutionApproach: Writing an unmodified page back to disk on eviction.
